text:
Emma: Quick sync — need a short, concrete pattern for SDK/API auth to customer KMS for both hosted control plane and Private deployments. Should cover env vars, Vault/SSM, console settings, rotation, envelope keys.
Raj: Avoid long-lived creds in env vars. Prefer platform identity (instance profile/managed identity/WIF) + Vault/dynamic secrets.
Maria: Distinguish control plane (our backend may call customer KMS in Private) vs customer workload (apps calling KMS). Different flows.
ops-bot: incident: last month a dev committed AWS keys in a test. Moving away from env vars helped.
Emma: For AWS SDKs what do we recommend? Order of precedence?
Raj: Use standard credential chain: env -> shared credentials file -> EC2/ECS role -> EKS IRSA. Recommend IRSA for k8s. If infra roles not available, fetch short-lived creds from Vault or Secrets Manager.
Maria: GCP: use Workload Identity Federation or GCE metadata. Avoid JSON key files. Azure: Managed Identities.
Emma: Envelope encryption: DEK lifecycle and rotation?
Raj: Use GenerateDataKey to create DEK, store ciphertext DEK with record. On rotation, rewrap (rewrap encrypted DEK with new CMK) or decrypt+re-encrypt as migration. Store key version id with each ciphertext.
Maria: Implementation notes: keep plaintext DEK in-memory only, never write to disk. Cache encrypted DEK but not plaintext. Zero memory when done if language supports.
Ops: Console UX question: should users paste keys/identifiers?
Raj: Console should accept resource identifiers (ARNs/key IDs/key ring names) and optionally a role/service account to assume. Do NOT accept raw key material.
security-bot: RBAC: follow least privilege. Example minimal AWS policy: "Action": ["kms:Encrypt","kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"], "Resource": "arn:aws:kms:...:key/..."
Emma: Quick pro/cons Vault vs Secrets Manager vs SSM?
Maria: Vault: dynamic creds, strong audit, good multi-cloud. Secrets Manager: managed, rotation hooks for some targets, CloudTrail. SSM SecureString: cheaper, fewer features. Store only identifiers in our config, not raw creds.
Raj: Bad pattern to show devs:
```
export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=AKIA...
export AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=...
# app reads these
```
Discourage that.
Emma: Recommended SDK config for our client libs:
1) Auto-detect platform identity (IRSA/role/managed identity/WIF)
2) Fallback to short-lived creds from Vault/Secrets Manager
3) Allow operator to supply a read-only credential mapping to an assumable role (no symmetric keys)
4) Local dev: use aws-vault / gcloud auth login.
Ops: Rotation playbook (outline): provision new CMK/version -> grant service principal -> update config or alias swap -> rewrap DEKs for active data -> revoke old grants post-migration.
Maria: Audit logging: require CloudTrail / KMS audit logs enabled; surface console warnings when disabled. Also keep our control-plane call logs when we proxy calls.
Raj: Cache plaintext DEK only for short TTL (e.g., 30s) to avoid too many KMS calls, bounded LRU cache, zero memory on eviction. For high-sensitivity private deployments consider mlock / OS page locking.
security-bot: Vault tokens: limited TTL and minted via role binding with MFA for human ops.
Emma: Action items: Raj -> 1-page impl doc + code samples for GenerateDataKey AWS/GCP/Azure. Maria -> RBAC templates and example IAM policies. Ops -> Console UX stub + validation + audit warning. I'll sync with Legal on audit retention.
Raj: will ping when draft ready.
Maria: starting policies this afternoon.
Ops: ticket assignments added.
Emma: Thanks everyone. If anyone has a small GCP DEK snippet add it later. :thumbsup:
